name: NRCan 2026-27 Canadian Critical Minerals Strategy Plan
known_limitations: The plan records intended program activity, spending, indicators, and targets. Planned spending and project-agreement work do not prove disbursement, construction, production growth, processing output, or successful project delivery.
automation_notes: Track final project agreements, fund launches, actual spending, permitted construction, commissioning, and reported production against the plan.
notes: The 2026-27 plan reports $432.842 million in planned spending for the horizontal initiative and a 2030 production target; both are forward-looking.
